messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: google code shutting down file hosting (Jan 2014)
parts:
Maybe because too many projects like ours moved to
GitHub and just used Google to distribute releases.

http://google-opensource.blogspot.com/2013/05/a-change-to-google-code-download-service.html

GitHub, alas, doesn't seem to have a way to distribute files.

I suppose can just move them to our own web server. The
traffic's not that heavy (1000 downloads of 50MB = 50GB, so
maybe we'll have to check our bandwidth allowances).

- Bob

Great --- that should work for the code. The latest
master has a predictable link, too:

I'd like to keep it downloadable itself so that people can

tracker and I don't know if one can disable them.

Also, it seems that Github allows download by tags:

https://codeload.github.com/stan-dev/stan/zip/v1.3.0

The downloaded file gets a nice name then: stan-1.3.0.zip
